On Friday 27 November 2026, a youth was allegedly linked to Jaish-e-Mohammed.
The Special Cell team monitored the suspect on social media for several days.
The suspect arrested by Delhi Police was recruited through social media.
The operative used the alias 'Umar' on social media, officials said.

stories.h: SP manifesto strategy: party to release three separate documents for 2027 elections

paras.t: On 26 November, the first manifesto (The forward-looking first document) would focus on young people, education, jobs, farmers, social justice, industry, Dalit issues, law and order, and MSMEs.
In the 2017 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, the Samajwadi Party released its manifesto 20 days before polling began.
In the 2022 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, the Samajwadi Party released its manifesto two days before the first phase (the first phase of polling on 10 February) of polling.
The Samajwadi Party proposed free Metro travel for girls and students in Lucknow.
The Samajwadi Party manifesto does not provide a detailed independent oversight mechanism for complaints against police personnel.
The manifesto proposes color-coded patrol vehicles, round-the-clock surveillance, district cyber units, and a dedicated Special Task Force to handle land disputes and illegal encroachments.
The manifesto (Sattais Ka Sankalp: PDA Ka Pran Patra – Jan-Man Ka Manifesto 2027) promises health insurance coverage of up to ₹10 lakh for families below the poverty line, Samajwadi Party said.
The party proposes free medical treatment for poor families and ₹2 lakh in financial assistance for self-employment.
The Bharatiya Janata Party criticized the manifesto as false.

stories.h: Hindu groups move High Court after TVK government skips Dipathoon lamp lighting

paras.t: On 20 November, the Supreme Court issued an order allowing a small team authorized by the temple administration to light a lamp on the Dipathoon.
On Tuesday 24 November 2026, the ceremonial lamp was lit at the customary location near the Ucchipillaiyar temple.
However, the lamp was not lit here.
The BJP held a protest demanding the lighting of the lamp on the Dipathoon as per the Supreme Court order.
On 20 November, the Supreme Court issued an order permitting the lighting of traditional lamps at the Dipathoon pillar.
They permitted lighting the lamp (Karthigai Deepam lamp) every year, but this dispute started over the demand to light a lamp on another stone pillar located on top of the hill.
The Supreme Court paused a wider Madras High Court judgment.
Madurai District Collector Nishant Krishnan imposed restrictions under Section 163 of the BNSS, prohibiting public gatherings and climbing the hill until Wednesday morning.
The Supreme Court permitted Hindu groups to light lamps at the Dipathoon in Tiruparankundram.

stories.h: Content advisory: Ministry reminds Netflix to block Pakistani shows

paras.t: On 27 November, the I&B Ministry asked Netflix to maintain the position that no Pakistani-origin film or series is available to subscribers in India, and the Indian Ministry of Information and Broadcasting issued a formal reminder to Netflix to refrain from streaming Pakistani-origin content in India.

On 8 May 2025, the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting issued an advisory asking streaming platforms to remove Pakistani content, and the government issued an advisory on 8 May 2025, during Operation Sindoor, asking all OTT platforms, media streaming services and intermediaries operating in India to discontinue content originating in Pakistan.

p.t: On 8 May 2025, the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting issued an advisory asking streaming platforms to remove Pakistani content,

and the government issued an advisory on 8 May 2025, during Operation Sindoor, asking all OTT platforms, media streaming services and intermediaries operating in India to discontinue content originating in Pakistan.

paras.t: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting reiterated an advisory issued on 8 May 2025.
In November 2026, the Indian government reiterated its position on Pakistani-origin content to Netflix regarding the show (‘Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo’) 'Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo'.
Netflix informed the Ministry in June 2025 that it did not make any film or series originating in Pakistan available to subscribers in India.
Zee5 complied with the direction.
The web series (Pakistani Content Amid Controversy Over Upcoming Web Series) Jo Bachay Sang Lo was scheduled for a global premiere on 4 December 2026.
The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting cited national security concerns as the reason for the direction.
Not every complaint automatically results in content being taken down.

stories.h: Sheshnag Lake controversy: government dispatches 12-member team to investigate excavator use

paras.t: On 23 November, A video showing heavy machinery, including JCBs and excavators, being used for road widening at Sheshnag Lake has recently gone viral.
The Supreme Court in 2012 issued directions regarding the Amarnath Yatra track in the case Court on their own motion vs Union of India and Others.
This month, a video showing an earthmover operating on the shores of Sheshnag Lake was posted to Instagram.
On 24 November, the Jammu and Kashmir government dispatched a 12-member inspection team to the lake.
On Tuesday, the PDP leaders attempted to trek from Chandanwari towards Sheshnag.
PDP president Mehbooba Mufti and party MLAs Waheed Para and Syed Muntazir Mehndi attempted to trek towards the lake on Tuesday morning.
Former Jammu and Kashmir chief minister Mufti visited Chandanwari and attempted to trek towards the lake.
The PDP leaders were stopped by police on Tuesday.
Mufti, PDP president, criticized the government for its response to the activity on Monday, saying that "The issue is very painful."

stories.h: Kolkata ceremony: Indian Navy takes delivery of final Project 17A frigate

paras.t: Rear Admiral RS Dhaliwal formally accepted the INS Vindhyagiri for the Indian Navy at a ceremony held at Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers in Kolkata yesterday.
From 1981 to 2012, the previous INS Vindhyagiri served in the Indian Navy for 31 years.
The Vindhyagiri was named after the Vindhyagiri mountain range in Karnataka.
It was launched by President Droupadi Murmu on 17 August 2023.
The Indian Navy received the INS Vindhyagiri, the seventh and final stealth frigate of the P-17A project yesterday.
Government Shipyard Reach Shipbuilders End Engineers delivered the P17A class guided-missile frigate Vindhyagiri to the Bharatiya Navy yesterday.
Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers Limited handed it over to the Navy in Kolkata yesterday.
The INS Vindhyagiri is 149 meters long and weighs 6,670 tons.
The construction of the INS Vindhyagiri utilized 75 percent indigenous materials, and approximately 75% of the warship's equipment and technology are indigenous.

stories.h: Supreme Court asserts Article 32 power to regulate packaged food labels

paras.t: On 27 November, the Supreme Court of India warned that it has jurisdiction under Article 32 to address the issue of packaged food warning labels.
The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India proposed a star-rating system for packaged food in 2022.
In October 2025, the government instructed the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India to withdraw the draft notification for a star-rating system.

On 27 November 2026, Justices JB Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran directed the FSSAI to consider the totality of specified ingredients rather than only added sugar, salt, or fat, and to ensure that labels for 'High Fat', 'High Sugar', or 'High Salt' were applied legibly, with the nutritional profile taking precedence over the extent of processing.

It directed the agency to create a comprehensive definition of High Fat Salt Sugar foods and work toward the phased, progressive reduction of threshold levels over time to improve the food environment.
The Supreme Court directed that the extent of processing involved in making food would have no bearing on the decision to label it.

Front-of-package nutrition labelling should treat total sugars and saturated fat as nutrients of concern alongside salt, the Supreme Court of India stated that consumption of toxic shelf-foods was driven by visual appeal and product advertising, stated that the right to live with human dignity includes the right to make informed choices regarding food, and said that threshold limits for nutrients should be determined by science rather than implementation difficulties.
Supreme Court said that "We have issued some directions which we feel, if implemented, will lead to healthier children. If taken in the right spirit, it will take the country to healthier times".
The Supreme Court invoked the right to make an informed food choice as a constitutional right under Article 21 of the Constitution.

stories.h: Defence update: CDS warns of Pakistan's space growth backed by China

paras.t: On 27 November, Chief of Defence Staff General NS Raja Subramani warned that Pakistan's expanding space capabilities, backed by China and potentially Turkey, could pose fresh security challenges for the country.
The Chief of Defence Staff made observations while addressing an event at the Vivekananda International Foundation yesterday.
Subramani delivered a talk at the Vivekananda International Foundation yesterday.
The General gave a lecture at the Vivekananda International Foundation on India's preparedness for future warfare today.
China may soon be able to disable or knock out satellites.
Subramani warned that the traditional distinction between war and peace was blurring, and Subramani warned countries are in a state of confrontation at many levels.
In response to this, India was working to strengthen its satellite surveillance system, including SBS-3.

India plans to add 52 dedicated satellites over the next three years through the Space Based Surveillance (SBS-III) programme, and it plans to launch 52 dedicated military satellites over the next three years under the SBS-III mission.
Space-based surveillance phase-III (SBS-3) is a system intended to increase India's surveillance capabilities.

stories.h: India fast bowler Mohammed Shami clarifies future in limited-overs cricket

paras.t: On 26 November, India fast bowler Mohammed Shami stated, "I have said this before: I will continue playing white-ball cricket, and if required, I will play red-ball cricket as well."
Shami aims to stay active in domestic cricket to assist younger athletes while concentrating on physical fitness, bowling rhythm, and enjoying the sport free from undue pressure.
He intends to continue playing for his State in domestic cricket, and preparation remains non-negotiable for him.
Last month, India fast bowler Shami called time on his Test career and announced his retirement from Test cricket.
On 26 November 2026, Shami dismissed suggestions that his retirement changed his approach towards the sport.
On 26 November, Shami said that he receives only what was destined for him by the Almighty and expressed that red-ball cricket should have some added fun.
He has the option of picking and choosing which matches to play, Shami said, adding that he would continue playing white-ball cricket and would play red-ball cricket if required.
Shami declared that "I am happy with whatever I have received."

He stated that "As long as you love cricket and enjoy playing the game, you should continue," stated that "Especially when you play for your State, experience matters a lot," and stated that "I have no regrets," Shami said.

stories.h: FSSAI investigation: regulator sanctions prosecution of Bisleri over unsafe water

paras.t: On 25 November, "The results will take at least a month or two," FSSAI CEO Rajit Punhani said.
The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India granted sanction to prosecute Bisleri International on 23 November.
On Wednesday 25 November 2026, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India launched a nationwide surveillance exercise to assess the quality of packaged drinking water.
Punhani, CEO of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), announced that the food regulator was collecting samples of packaged drinking water from across the country.
On 27 November 2026, the FSSAI started an investigation into the quality of packaged drinking water brands.
"It's a very big country. So I think it will take at least a month or two," Punhani said.
Bisleri International asserts that its packaged drinking water is safe for consumption and maintains that no stocks of the batch under the FSSAI scanner are currently available in the market.
The report on the investigation was expected to be released in approximately two months.
The regulatory action against Bisleri International was limited to a single sample from batch number GO 270 collected from the Goa plant.

stories.h: Passport notice to Saurav Das: Chennai office flags document discrepancies, seeks clarification

paras.t: On 25 November, the Chennai Regional Passport Office issued a show-cause notice to Saurav Das regarding alleged discrepancies in his passport, external affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said.
On Monday late night, Cockroach Janata Party co-convener and spokesperson Saurav Das claimed in a video that he was stopped at Delhi Airport from traveling to London.

On Tuesday, Saurav Das was stopped from boarding his London-bound flight at Delhi airport, and the Indian government prevented him from traveling because it feared his views reaching international academic institutions.
Saurav Das claims he was invited by the Oxford University Students Union to give a lecture.
On Wednesday, Saurav Das filed a petition in the Delhi Bench, and on 25 November 2026, the Cockroach Janta Party chief spokesperson moved the Delhi High Court.
Saurav Das claims that no order was shown to him, stating, "No order was shown to me. No LOC, no prohibition by any authority from letting me travel."
The Indian government was seeking clarification regarding Saurav Das' place of birth following reports of discrepancies, Jaiswal said.
The Union government issued a look-out circular against Saurav Das.
The Centre informed the court that the Mumbai Police has issued a Lookout Circular against Saurav Das.

stories.h: Extradition dispute: Bangladesh Speaker threatens International Court of Justice move against India

paras.t: In 2024, former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina fled the nation after her government was ousted by a series of student-led protests, and in August 2024 fled Dhaka, fled to India and fled Bangladesh following a mass uprising.

In November 2025, Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal sentenced Sheikh Hasina to death in absentia for crimes against humanity over the 2024 crackdown on protesters, and she has been living in India since 5 August 2024.
The Indian Ministry of External Affairs was examining the extradition request for former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina in accordance with established procedures, Randhir Jaiswal said.
Humaiun Kobir said that if she returns on 16 December, she must return in handcuffs as a prisoner.

Bangladesh Parliament Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed suggested on Thursday during his six-day visit to Pakistan that Bangladesh could approach the International Court of Justice if India refuses to hand over former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, and he stated that she would not return to Bangladesh for the next 10 years.
On Thursday, State Minister for Foreign Affairs Kobir referred to former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina as a terrorist, saying she is a terrorist.
Kobir branded Sheikh Hasina a thorn in bilateral relations and described the presence of the former prime minister in India as a thorn in bilateral ties.
Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina seeks to return to Bangladesh on 16 December, the Sheikh Hasina said.
Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina faces a death sentence handed down in absentia by a special tribunal.

stories.h: Revised delimitation framework raises Lok Sabha seats to 815 by 2051

paras.t: On Friday, the proposed 50% Lok Sabha seat hike would broadly preserve each state's share of the House.
On Monday, the Constitution (132nd Amendment) Bill, 2026, was slated for introduction in the Lok Sabha.
The existing distribution of Lok Sabha seats was based on the 1971 Census and the 1973 delimitation.
They were being retained for determining the respective share (share of states in LS) of states in the House.
The distribution continued for 50 years because a readjustment would adversely affect the proportion of States.
The proportion of States stabilised population.
The Union Cabinet was chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav termed the delimitation move BJP's biggest mistake and said it was being introduced to win the Uttar Pradesh election where the party was looking to score a hat-trick of wins.
The Bill proposes to increase the maximum strength of state Assemblies from 500 to 650.

stories.h: MotoGP retirement: Marc Marquez confirms Valencia Grand Prix is final race

paras.t: Ducati announced Marc Marquez's retirement on social media yesterday, saying, "It is official. @marcmarquez93 has decided to retire from @motogp, and the 2026 Valencia Grand Prix will be his final race as a professional rider and with the #DucatiLenovoTeam".
Marquez is 33 years old.
He made the decision to retire after last month's Japanese Grand Prix due to the physical and mental toll of his battles for fitness.
On Friday 27 November 2026, Marquez recorded a video message at the Ricardo Tormo circuit.

He announced he would retire after the season finale in Valencia, having previously clinched his eighth top-tier motorcycle racing championship and won his eighth MotoGP title at the Portuguese Grand Prix.

p.t: He announced he would retire after the season finale in Valencia,
having previously clinched his eighth top-tier motorcycle racing championship and won his eighth MotoGP title at the Portuguese Grand Prix.

paras.t: Marquez has 80 individual race wins in the top category.
He trailed Bezzecchi by 102 points in early June.
On Friday 27 November 2026, Marquez announced his retirement from MotoGP, saying, "This will be my last race in MotoGP."

"I first need to understand what I need in my next life," Marquez said, adding, "Thank you to everyone who's been part of the journey," and stating, "Thank you to everyone who's been part of this journey, I hope you've enjoyed it as much as I have," while noting, "Sometimes you need to understand the situation, but it's true that the situation this year was on the limit."

stories.h: Order shift: global brands move 2,200 crore from Bangladesh to India

paras.t: Between 1 November and 18 November brands transferred orders worth approximately 2,200 crore.
Global brands moved their production from Bangladesh to other Asian countries, including India.
They transferred orders worth more than 4,000 crore to India and other countries in November.
Bangladesh raised the minimum monthly wage (Minimum Wage) for garment workers to USD 136.
Bangladesh followed the same path as Pakistan.
International retailers shifted about $254 million away from Bangladesh between 1 November and 18, factory owners said.
India received the bulk of the diverted business, an unnamed source said.
Manufacturers around Dhaka lost an estimated 20 to 25 production days due to disruptions, the source said.
Protests caused more than $400 million in production losses for the Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association.

pp: Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association

stories.h: New bill mandates 15-year women reservation starting from 2023 amendment enforcement

paras.t: On 27 November, the statement of objects and reasons of the bill clearly states that its purpose is to provide immediate one-third reservation for women in Lok Sabha, state assemblies, and union territory assemblies.
The Constitution (132nd Amendment) Bill, 2026, is to be introduced in the Lok Sabha.
The bill [Samvidhan (132wan sanshodhan) vidheyak] does not specify whether the 2021 census or the 2027 census data would be used for delimitation.
It only provides that delimitation would be carried out based on the latest officially published census as of the date the amendment comes into force.
Further procedure would be decided after it was introduced in the Lok Sabha.
Changes in the delimitation bill (Parisiman Bill) have been approved by the Modi Cabinet.
The new bill talks about using the latest published census data available at that time for delimitation when the amendment was implemented.

Women from Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes have also been included in this, and rotation of seats reserved for scheduled caste and tribe women would be done within the concerned reserved constituencies.

p.t: Women from Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes have also been included in this,
and rotation of seats reserved for scheduled caste and tribe women would be done within the concerned reserved constituencies.

paras.t: The existing share of different states in Lok Sabha would remain almost like before, and the right to rotation of reserved seats, meaning changing seats in different elections, would also be with Parliament.

stories.h: Opposition parties challenge government plans for delimitation and women's reservation legislation

paras.t: On Friday, the central government (The Union government) is confident of securing a two-thirds majority for delimitation and women's reservation legislation.
The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam was passed unanimously in Parliament in September 2023.
The Constitution Amendment Bill failed to clear the required two-thirds mark of 360 votes in April.
The law for women's reservation was notified at 10:40 pm on 16 April 2026.
On Friday, the NDA needs additional support to meet the two-thirds majority in Lok Sabha.
The Congress President demanded the immediate implementation of the Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam.
The Prime Minister is a nervous and rattled leader who is under siege, Jairam Ramesh said.
Gyanesh Kumar, the Chief Election Commissioner, has made a mockery of electoral roll preparation and destroyed the integrity of the electoral process.
Akhilesh Yadav criticises the proposed Delimitation Bill.

stories.h: CDS Raja Subramani rejects foreign war models for India's specific security needs

paras.t: While learning from other countries' war experiences is necessary, India must prepare a distinct operational model based on its geographical conditions, security needs, and military capabilities rather than directly adopting foreign strategies, Chief of Defence Staff General N.S. Chief of Defence Staff General N S Raja Subramani said.
Chief of Defence Staff General N. S. Subramani delivered a speech on future warfare and multi-domain operations yesterday at an event held by the Vivekananda International Foundation in Delhi.
Subramani took over from General Anil Chauhan as CDS.
Joint headquarters and theatre commands were viewed as a fundamental basis for joint military operations.
India needed to be joint in design and multi-domain oriented, Subramani said.

India must develop a unique war strategy to address challenges from China and Pakistan, and the country was working towards increasing jointness and integration among the three armed forces, Chief of Defence Staff General N.S. Subramani said yesterday.
Warfare was rapidly changing due to technology, and the distinction between war and peace was disappearing, Subramani said.
Efforts were being made to modernize the framework of the military's electronic warfare system, as stated by him.
India must prepare to fight simultaneously on all fronts including land, air, water, space, and cyber, Chief of Defence Staff General N.S. Subramani said.

stories.h: South India representation at risk as Chandrababu Naidu backs delimitation bill

paras.t: On Friday 27 November Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu issued a statement regarding the delimitation bill.
Naidu questioned all opposition parties.
Telugu Desam Party announced its full support for the central government's decision to introduce electoral delimitation along with the women's reservation bill.

On Friday, Naidu spoke to media and stated that Telugu Desam Party fully supports the central government's move, expressing support for the central government's decision to move forward with the delimitation of constituencies and the implementation of the women's reservation.
On Friday, Naidu arrived in Delhi ahead of the special parliament meeting.
Naidu addressed a media conference in New Delhi alongside Union Minister HD Kumaraswamy and other Union ministers.
A one-day special meeting of Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha has been convened to pass the revised delimitation and women's reservation bill proposed by the central government.
On Friday, Naidu urged all opposition parties to support the proposed delimitation and women's reservation bills in Parliament.
"Today, I came all the way here to support a historical initiative taken by Naidu said.

stories.h: Delimitation bill: government needs 360 votes to secure constitutional amendment

paras.t: The Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill was defeated in the Lok Sabha on 17 April.
Congress MP Manoj Kumar said on Friday that some DMK MPs had indicated their willingness to support the proposed Delimitation Bill under certain conditions.

The government appears to have met the conditions in the final draft of the legislation, while it was preparing for another test of strength in Parliament with back-channel conversations, support from regional parties, and fresh proposals.
The Union Cabinet approved a constitutional amendment bill to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats by 50 percent on 28 November 2026.
A parliamentary session is scheduled for 30 November 2026.
Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju requested the Lok Sabha Speaker and the Rajya Sabha Chairman to reconvene the Lower House on 30 November and the Upper House on 2 December.
The government (the BJP-led NDA government) was counting on regional parties, including the DMK and the Sharadchandra Pawar-led NCP (SP), to bridge the gap.
Rebel Trinamool Congress MPs have flocked to the obscure NCPI.
The government was expected to introduce a fresh delimitation bill addressing earlier objections.

stories.h: Washington blames Indian manufacturing practices for undermining American commerce

paras.t: On 27 November, Washington blames structural excess industrial capacity and manufacturing practices in trading partner countries for undermining American commerce.
In February 2026, India and America negotiated an interim trade agreement, for which a framework was prepared.
It reduced punitive tariffs on most Indian goods from 50 per cent to 18 per cent.
On Wednesday, the United States proposed imposing tariffs on several countries, including a 25% tariff on India and a 40% tax on China.
It proposed a net tariff of 25% on goods imported from India, Office of the U.S. Trade Representative said.
The United States investigated the manufacturing sectors of other countries under Section 301 of its trade law.
The United States administration claimed that unfair trade policies and excess industrial production were harming its domestic manufacturing sector.

Bharat's Ministry of Commerce and Industry reiterated its commitment to work with America to conclude the trade agreement expeditiously, in line with the declaration of 2 February 2026, and the joint statement issued on 7 February 2026.

The Section 301 investigation covered 16 economies including China, the European Union, India, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Vietnam, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Switzerland, Norway, Singapore, Bangladesh and Cambodia.

stories.h: D. Gukesh forces Javokhir Sindarov to make 11 moves in 13 minutes

paras.t: During Thursday's third game of the World Championship match in Geneva against Javokhir Sindarov, D. Ruy Lopez D Gukesh performed like a computer program and consistently found the top moves.
The defending champion started as an underdog in the World Chess Championships.
The defending champion was behind the clock in both of the earlier games.
Gukesh's lead in time continued to increase during the game.
On Thursday, Gukesh chose the Rio de Janeiro variation of Gukesh.
At one point on Thursday, Sindarov had to make 11 moves in 13 minutes.
Sindarov had about 7 seconds for the last move, D. Gukesh said.
Sindarov stated he was not thinking too much about the scores regarding the pressure of three successive draws.
For the first time in the match, Gukesh blitzed out his opening moves while Sindarov remained glued to his chair spending considerable time navigating the position.

stories.h: MK Stalin rejects Delimitation Bill compromise, demands 25-year freeze on seat changes

paras.t: "The DMK stands firm on these two demands and will continue to do so," MK Stalin said yesterday.
The Narendra Modi government failed to get the required two-third majority for the Delimitation Bill in April.
On Friday, Congress-DMK said that the DMK demands a 25-year freeze on delimitation and a uniform 50% increase in Lok Sabha seats across all states.
Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam accused the DMK of potentially moving closer to the Bharatiya Janata Party over the delimitation issue.

The support [the support of 22 Lok Sabha members from Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK)] of 22 DMK Lok Sabha members was required for the government to achieve a two-third majority for the Delimitation Bill.
A two-thirds majority in both Houses was required for the constitutional amendment.
The NDA government was expected to introduce a revised delimitation proposal to facilitate the implementation of women's reservation from the 2029 general elections.
The Congress-DMK fears that increasing Lok Sabha seats based on population would disadvantage states that have performed well in population control.

stories.h: SBI Card users face new 1 percent fee on high-value fuel spending

paras.t: SBI Card will apply a 1% fee plus GST on individual transportation transactions exceeding ₹30,000.
On 1 December 2026, SBI Card will apply a 1% fee on the entire fuel bill if cumulative spending exceeds ₹50,000 in a billing cycle, updating an earlier version.
It would apply a 1% fee to individual transportation transactions exceeding ₹30,000 starting 1 December.
Credit card users will face additional charges on certain high-value transactions starting 1 December 2026.
It is introducing an additional 1 per cent fee on certain high-value transportation and fuel transactions.
The charge would be calculated on the entire eligible fuel expenditure, not just the amount exceeding the limit.
State Bank of India customers may have to pay additional charges on certain transactions starting 1 December.
From 2 to 4 December, the Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee will meet to review interest rates.
The deadline (Advance Tax Deadline) for filing belated ITRs for FY 2025–26 is 31 December 2026.

stories.h: Coach Manish Ojha backs Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to become India's all-format star

paras.t: On 26 November, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has an extraordinary understanding of the game for his age, Coach Manish Ojha said.
Sooryavanshi is a phenomenal left-hand batter.
On Thursday, New Zealand leg-spinner Ish Sodhi spoke about the potential of Sooryavanshi to play Test cricket, when he was asked whether the batter could make the transition to red-ball cricket.
Sooryavanshi was previously criticized by some as being merely a Twenty20 slogger.

Ojha said that Sooryavanshi was bound to become an all-format player for India and possesses game awareness beyond his years, mentioning that he tried to soothe him by noting that even the great Sachin Tendulkar did not score in every innings, and observing that Sooryavanshi's mentality and game analysis resemble those of a 30 or 32-year-old.
Ojha said that Sooryavanshi was anticipated to represent India across all formats in the future.

Sodhi said, "I haven’t seen anyone in my career strike the ball as consistently as he does," noting that he and Abhishek Sharma deliver massive power for India's future, and suggesting that Sooryavanshi's aggressive style could benefit Test matches when pursuing large targets, despite uncertainties regarding his capacity to bat for extended periods and defend reliably.

Sodhi stated that Sooryavanshi's technique is sufficient given his ability to strike the ball all around the ground, and noted that Hagley Oval flattens out significantly in the fourth innings, making it difficult for opposing bowlers to silence Sooryavanshi there, while adding that he has not observed Sooryavanshi's defensive skills very often.

stories.h: Abu Dhabi meeting: India and UAE accelerate next-generation defence equipment production

paras.t: On 26 November, the 14th Joint Defence Cooperation Committee meeting was co-chaired by Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh and Lieutenant General Ibrahim Nasser M. Ibrahim Nasser M Al Alawi.
The meeting focused on advancing plans established under the India-UAE Strategic Defence Partnership formed in May 2026.
The India-UAE Strategic Defence Partnership Framework was signed in May 2026 during Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to the UAE.
On 27 November 2026, India and the UAE agreed to "accelerate co-development and co-production of next-generation defence equipment."

On Thursday, both sides agreed to strengthen bilateral defence engagement across areas including defence industry, innovation, advanced technology, AI, cyber security, military training, and maritime safety.
On Thursday 26 November 2026, a B2B interaction between defence industries of the two countries was held on the sidelines of the meeting [14th Joint Defence Cooperation Committee (JDCC) meeting].
The meeting provided strategic direction to the initiatives laid out in the India-UAE Strategic Defence Partnership Framework.
India and the UAE agreed to expand defence cooperation in manufacturing, innovation, advanced technologies, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, military training, and maritime safety.
India and the United Arab Emirates held the 14th meeting of the Joint Defence Cooperation Committee in Abu Dhabi.

stories.h: Delimitation strategy: Rahul Gandhi confirms Congress and DMK will block bill

paras.t: On 27 November, "Lok Delimitation Bill Ka Virodh Congress-DMK K.," Rahul Gandhi said.
The Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026, and other bills failed to clear Parliament in April due to a lack of a two-thirds majority.
On Friday afternoon, the Congress Parliamentary Strategy Committee held a meeting at Sonia Gandhi's residence in New Delhi.
MK Stalin targeted the former ally Congress party with allusions.
The government is prepared to introduce the Delimitation Bill in the upcoming parliamentary session.

The BJP is confident of receiving the necessary support to pass the Delimitation Bill, and it appears confident of having enough support to pass the delimitation bill in next week's Parliament session.

Congress would strongly oppose the Delimitation Bill regardless of whether the opposition has sufficient numbers to stop it, our decision is clear, Virodh, and Congress-DMK should walk with them, Rahul Gandhi said.
Rahul Gandhi stated that all MPs must convey to the public and houses that BJP wants to do delimitation for its political benefit, Unnamed source said.

On Friday, Stalin said that political leaders from across the country came together for the first time in Chennai, and added that media speculations or whispers of backstabbers cannot shake their stance in any way.

The Allahabad High Court in May directed the Central Bureau of Investigation and the Enforcement Directorate to verify the allegations made in a petition filed by Bharatiya Janata Party activist S. Vignesh Shishir and file an affidavit detailing status of enquiry.
In a subsequent order dated 20 July, the Allahabad High Court expressed dissatisfaction with the Central Bureau of Investigation’s response.

On 17 August, the top court directed that no report shall be submitted by Central Bureau of Investigation, Enforcement Directorate or any other agencies as per the Allahabad High Court’s order in May.
The Allahabad High Court observed that the agencies could take appropriate steps as legally permissible, taking note of the agencies ' submissions.
In May, the Allahabad High Court’s Lucknow Bench directed the CBI, ED, Serious Fraud Investigation Office and other authorities to file their responses to the allegations.
On Monday, the High Court asked the CBI and ED to verify the allegations in accordance with the law and take appropriate action if necessary.
In July, the High Court directed the Central Bureau of Investigation to file a fresh affidavit explaining the status of its inquiry.

stories.h: Nutrition accountability: Mallikarjun Kharge questions Modi government on anaemia survey results

paras.t: On 25 November, Mallikarjun Kharge asked, "After 12 years of the Modi government, multiple nutrition schemes, fortified rice and iron supplementation programmes, where is the accountability?"

On Tuesday, The Congress attacked the Centre over a report on malnutrition and anaemia in the country, cited an official report on Gujarat's anaemia prevalence in 2023-25, and questioned Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda.
Kharge questioned the Centre's nutrition record after a national survey found widespread anaemia among women and young children.

61.4 per cent of adolescent girls aged 10 to 19, 63.8 per cent of women aged 20 to 59 and 66.2 per cent of women of reproductive age in Gujarat had anaemia, according to the Union health ministry's report, Jairam Ramesh said.
In Kerala, 21.4 per cent of adolescent girls, 28 per cent of women aged 20 to 59, and 29.1 per cent of women of reproductive age had anaemia, Ramesh said.
Gujarat recorded the highest anaemia prevalence among children aged 12 to 59 months at 56.5 per cent, while Kerala recorded the lowest at 14.5 per cent, Ramesh said.

Kharge pointed out that nearly 44% of funds released under the original POSHAN Abhiyaan remained unutilised, asked how India could realise its demographic dividend while millions continued to face malnutrition, asked how India can realise its demographic dividend when millions of women and children suffer from malnutrition, and stated that "The Modi Govt's own ICMR-SAMPADA report reveals that 55.9% of women of reproductive age are anaemic."
Nearly two-thirds of adolescent girls and boys are deficient in Vitamin B12, Kharge said.
42% of children aged 1-4 years are anaemic, Kharge said.

stories.h: Trade policy: Donald Trump prepares new tariffs on India and China

paras.t: On Wednesday 25 November 2026, Donald Trump was preparing to impose new tariffs on India, China, and the European Union.
Trump visited China twice this year.
Trump signed a bill in September to impose a 100 percent tariff on India.
On Tuesday 24 November, the Trump administration was preparing new tariffs on China, the European Union and more than a dozen other economies.
On Wednesday 25 November, Trump was preparing to impose new tariffs on several countries including Bharat.
"Bharat is sitting on an economic disaster," Rahul Gandhi said.
"India is the fastest-growing economy under Modi's leadership," Pradeep Bhandari said in response.
"Trump may impose new tariffs on 16 countries including India and China," Wall Street Journal said, adding that India may face another round of tariffs from Trump.
"No world power wants to let India rise," Mohan Bhagwat said.

stories.h: Ministers must cancel foreign trips to prepare for 15 December Parliament session

paras.t: The Monsoon Session of Parliament remained unprorogued as of Wednesday night, more than 100 days after being adjourned indefinitely on 13 August.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi asked his ministerial colleagues to complete preparations for the next session of Parliament before 15 December.
On Wednesday, he held a central cabinet meeting.

The Cabinet Committee on Parliamentary Affairs would decide the commencement date and duration of the next session, and the Parliamentary Affairs Kie Cabinet Samity would decide the final date of the Parliament Session.
The Winter Session is likely from 15 December as the government seeks to push the Delimitation Bill.
It was considering convening the session before 15 December, with the Cabinet Committee on Parliamentary Affairs expected to decide their dates and duration.
Government preparations, opposition protests, and the fate of the delimitation-linked bill were expected to shape proceedings of the next session.
The government was preparing to introduce a Delimitation Bill.

It may introduce a Mahila Reservation Bill related to delimitation in the upcoming Parliament Session, and attention is likely to be on whether it introduces the delimitation-linked women's reservation bill during the upcoming session.

stories.h: Space mission: China launches Shenzhou-24 with first foreign astronaut on board

paras.t: On Wednesday 25 November 2026, China launched Shenzhou-24 with a Pakistani astronaut, making history with its first foreign crew member.
Space cooperation between China and Pakistan dates back to the early 1990s.
China built its own orbital station after it was kept out of the ISS programme amid concerns about the role of the People’s Liberation Army in its space programme.
In May 2026, China launched the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft carrying three astronauts.
On Wednesday 25 November 2026, China launched the Shenzhou-24 mission to China's Tiangong space station from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center.
It separated from its launch vehicle and entered its designated orbit.
Flight engineer Wu Yi Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is the first foreign national to join a crewed mission under China's manned space programme and the first foreign astronaut to head to the station.
Tiangong is smaller than the multinational International Space Station.
On Tuesday, Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif posted a message on X.

stories.h: US proposes 25 percent tariffs on Indian goods in new trade action

paras.t: On Wednesday, US President Donald Trump administration proposed fresh tariffs on imports from 14 major trading partners, including China, India, the European Union and Japan.
Trump renewed his push to protect domestic industries.
The US administration intends to combat structural excess industrial capacity.

The US Trade Representative stated the new duties were aimed at countries that "creates, sustains, or contributes to structural excess capacity and production in manufacturing sectors through various acts, policies, and practices that we find to be unreasonable and burden or restrict US commerce", USTR said.
The administration (The United States) proposed tariffs on 14 trading partners to address structural excess industrial capacity.
On Wednesday, the United States announced plans to impose tariffs of up to 25 per cent on Indian goods.
The proposals include an additional 20 per cent tariff on Chinese goods.
On Wednesday 25 November 2026, the United States proposed fresh tariffs on imports from India and other economies.
Other economies facing the proposed levies included Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia, South Korea, Malaysia, Singapore, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand and Vietnam.

stories.h: Extradition request update: India examines Dhaka demand for Sheikh Hasina

paras.t: On 25 November, "The extradition request is being examined in line with our established processes," External Affairs Ministry Randhir Jaiswal said.
16 December marks Bangladesh's Victory Day.
Her proposed return has drawn strong reactions in Bangladesh.
A student led uprising ended her 15-year rule.

Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal sentenced Sheikh Hasina to death in absentia for crimes against humanity over the 2024 crackdown on protesters, and she has been living in India since 5 August 2024.
She was sentenced to death in absentia in November 2025 for crimes against humanity, and she has been living in India since 5 August 2024 when she fled Bangladesh following a student led uprising.
On Tuesday, Bangladesh's State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir briefed foreign diplomats at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Dhaka.
On Wednesday, India's Ministry of External Affairs Jaiswal held a bi-weekly press briefing.
On Wednesday 25 November 2026, the Ministry of External Affairs Jaiswal addressed a bi-weekly media briefing in New Delhi.

stories.h: India and China conclude 10 days of military talks along Arunachal frontier

paras.t: Military talks between India and China began on 8 November and continued for nearly 10 days.
On 6 September and 7 September 2026, the first Senior Highest Military Commander-Level Flag Meeting in the eastern sector was held.
The second round of talks took place on 6-7 September after the first Corps Commander-level meeting in the eastern sector, which was held at the Wacha-Damai Border Personnel Meeting points.
Starting on 8 November, India and China held a second round of core commander-level military talks in Arunachal Pradesh.
The talks took place amidst tension at the Line of Actual Control in Arunachal Pradesh.
The discussions focused on setting out clear engagement protocols, avoiding friction, keeping lines of communication open, and preventing local confrontations from escalating.
They included a meeting in Wacha-Damai to discuss preventing clashes during patrols and keeping channels of communication open.
The talks came amid concerns over rising tensions in the region.
In November Lieutenant General Girish Kalia led the Indian delegation in talks with his Chinese counterpart.
